name: Data.omega_zpow_ne_one
summary: At a place w that is not chosen ω(D)(w) = 1 and both sides fail; at a chosen place ω(D)(w) has order Mω(P, s(D)), so ω(D)(w)^n = 1 iff Mω(P, s(D)) ∣ n, impossible for 0 < |n| ≤ 8·m(D) < N₁(D)·d(P) ≤ Mω(P, s(D)).

steps.claim: Split on whether w is chosen. If not, ω(D)(w) = 1, so (ω^n)(w) = 1 and both sides of the equivalence are false. If w is chosen, ω(D)(w)^n = 1 if and only if orderOf(ω(D)(w)) = Mω(P, s(D)) divides n (`Data.orderOf_ω`), so it remains to show that Mω(P, s(D)) does not divide |n|.
steps.lean: by_cases D.IsChosen w <;> simp [*, ← orderOf_dvd_iff_zpow_eq_one, orderOf_ω, Int.natCast_dvd]

steps.claim: If Mω(P, s(D)) divided |n| then so would N₁(D)·d(P) (`Parameters.N₁_mul_d_dvd_M_omega`); but 0 < |n| (n ≠ 0) and |n| ≤ 8·m(D) < N₁(D)·d(P) (`nat_lt_of_hasLogBound`), and a positive number is not divisible by a larger one.
